resources.string: Could not load the card database: %1$s
The card database came back empty.
The app reads your cards from the screen while you scroll through My Cards in the game.
In My Cards choose the view with 3 cards per row. Only that view shows how many copies you own.
Tap Start, then open the game. A small button stays on screen.
Scroll slowly and pause for a moment on every screen, so the numbers can appear.
Tap Stop on the small button. You can then check the result before it is saved.

resources.string: PocketDeck scrolls the list for you, from the top to the end. Do not touch the screen while it runs; tap Stop on the small button to end early.
To scroll for you, switch on "PocketDeck auto-scroll" in the Accessibility settings. It only performs swipes and reads nothing on the screen.
